tools.name: get_services
tools.description: The menu with today's prices in US dollars. The price shown is the total: stains, sand, pet hair and smells are included.

tools.name: find_open_times
tools.description: Open visit times in the next days (Jacksonville time). Mornings are 7 to 11 AM, afternoons 12:30 to 5 PM; Monday, Wednesday and Friday are mornings only; Saturday is closed. Set whole_day true for The Full Package or more than one car: only days with the whole day open are listed.

tools.name: book_visit
tools.description: Books one visit, paid at the visit. Only when the person asked you to book and confirmed every field. David texts them to confirm. Pick a date and block from find_open_times; for service "package" the block is the whole day (send "Morning").
